proposed_exact_semantics.admission: Within a NEW coordinator only, derive a finite descriptor keyed by each existing case name and exact SQL SHA; reject unknown/missing/duplicate/changed clauses at pure load_inputs before any process. Values-only runtime placeholders must not change the reviewed privilege shape. No general SQL permission inference or executing a parser against a database.
proposed_exact_semantics.INSERT: Literal VALUES only in all43 current cases: table INSERT OR INSERT on every explicit target column. No SELECT requirement is invented because these exact statements have no RETURNING, SELECT source, FROM or ON CONFLICT. Any new clause rejects admission.
proposed_exact_semantics.UPDATE: (table UPDATE OR UPDATE on every SET target column) AND (table SELECT OR SELECT on every actual WHERE/RHS/RETURNING referenced column). All current RHS values and RETURNING 1 are literal. Read and written sets remain separate even when they overlap.
proposed_exact_semantics.DELETE: Mandatory table DELETE AND (table SELECT OR SELECT on every actual WHERE/USING/RETURNING referenced column). All41 exact cases have no USING and RETURNING 1; predicates read id, except UserRole reads user_id and role. A true id SELECT must never substitute for false DELETE.
proposed_exact_semantics.SELECT: The2 count(id)/WHERE id cases require table SELECT OR SELECT on id. The9 provider SELECT 1 FROM table cases have no column reference and require SELECT on the relation or at least one actual source-known column; use a valid has_any_column_privilege(...,SELECT) or a source-enumerated column OR, independently reviewed. Empty read set must not become an automatic allow.
proposed_exact_semantics.TRUNCATE: All4 require table TRUNCATE only; do not call has_column_privilege with TRUNCATE.
proposed_exact_semantics.provider_function: All9 exact calls retain only their intended schema USAGE comparison and SCHEMA denial maximum, matched to the actual source-known function call shape. No unrelated table privileges, deeper function result, NULL argument validity or private helper behavior claim.

proposed_exact_semantics.typed_comparison: Query only valid privilege types; expected booleans come from the already full-source-compared native nonowner ACL and exact known column/function inventory. plain_english: The checker asked the database a question that does not exist: can this person DELETE one column? DELETE needs permission for the whole table. It can also need permission to read the columns used to find the row. The new plan checks those two things separately and writes down a few safe clues if its own check breaks. It changes no locks, keys or database rules.
